verdict.rationale: Vanta's own risk product says it 'automates reminders and workflows to regularly assess', which is a thin first-party claim of recurring workflows. Continuous monitoring and automated tests run on Vanta's own cadence, not on schedules the user defines, and API, webhook, and MCP evidence covers one-off calls or event notifications rather than recurring schedules. Missing for 10: documented user-configurable scheduling of jobs or workflows (cadence, triggers, management), coverage beyond risk assessments, any API or agent-accessible scheduling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
